name: Odón (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a green chevron pointing to the fly bearing a wreath, from which three green horizontal stripes extend to the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Odón; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: chevron issuing from the hoist corners
wreath with a ring on the chevron
three horizontal stripes to the fly
